meta.name: GL-08 Roundup to Border BV - PxP MOP check - 400 psig drive
meta.notes: Re-run of Feb 2026 tender purge (EM-US-Q-21116, P66 Glacier GL-08) in v30 engine. Profile + point-by-point MOP from client file "GL-08 Roundup to Billings 10 inch Crude Point by Point MOP Profile (ACTIVE) (3).xlsm" (HTEST_MOP_PSI = lower of 80% hydro / 72% SMYS). Purge Roundup (MP 0) -> Border BV (MP 25.326), fluid exit Billings receiver trap (MP 53.209). Variant: 400 psig max injection/drive (was 499), 1.69 MMscf budget, 100 psig exit. Station MOPs (setpoint sheet): Roundup 1390 / Billings 760 psig.
